sprint_impact.candidate_B_qwen_06b: Preflight PASS. Ready for quality evaluation.
sprint_impact.candidate_C_bge_m3: ELIMINATED. BGE-M3 crashes identically to P1C. Both GGUF variants fail under sustained load.
sprint_impact.replacement_candidates: voyage-4-nano and jina-v5-small-retrieval both pass preflight (new findings — they were not stable in P1C but are now). Either could serve as a candidate C replacement IF the sprint plan is amended to substitute the model. This requires a governance decision: replacing BGE-M3 with a different model changes the controlled comparison.

governing_principle: Preflight failure means the candidate cannot be evaluated on this host. It does NOT mean the model has been proven inferior as a retrieval model. BGE-M3 may be viable on a different host/provider with a non-GGUF deployment. The conclusion is operational, not qualitative.
